name: Organic Materials
description: Classifications of energetic materials, design of novel energetic materials, chemistry of nitrogen-based explosives, polynitropolycycloalkanes, synthetic routes to nitrate esters, synthetic routes to aromatic C-Nitro compounds. Herein, synthetic routes to N-Nitro functionality, nitramines and their derivatives, N-heterocycles, miscellaneous explosive compounds and new energetic materials of the future will be discussed.
